consequence: The rundown of up to four trains is deadheaded against closed valves: the header rises to the shut-off head of the trains' rundown pumps (not in the files, D-023 (3)); a closure of a DN 900 ESD valve at 3.4 m/s faster than intended gives a pressure surge in LNG-1001 and the trains' rundown lines (about +1,750 kPa for an instant closure, D-023 (3)); possible flange or gasket failure and an LNG release in the tank area; trains upset (outside the battery limit).

consequence: A DN 900 rundown valve closes in a few seconds against the full rundown at 3.4 m/s, before or as XS-1100 trips the trains: surge of up to about +1,750 kPa for an instant closure (D-023 (3)) in LNG-1001 and the trains' rundown lines, beyond the 15 barg design; no surge relief on the rundown (PSV-1121..PSV-1123 are thermal relief only); flange or gasket failure, LNG release in the tank area or at the battery limit.

intent: Receive up to 3,365 t/h (~7,560 m3/h) of subcooled LNG at -161.5 degC and 215 kPa(a) from four trains (LNG-1001, LNG-1012..LNG-1014, each with its BL ESD valve XV-1111..XV-1114 and
cause: A fill change (SEQ-FILL-CHANGE) in which the new selection valve is commanded open from its HS but does not open (actuator or solenoid fault, valve stuck closed, an air supply isolated): I-103 counts it as open once its open command has been held for the stroke time (no position switch on XV-1106..XV-1109 at basic), so it releases the close command of the old valve, and the operator's local check and 'PI-1104 steady' of SEQ-FILL-CHANGE S1 are the only proof; likewise the other tank counted as taking the rundown because one of its selection valves is commanded open while it is stuck closed or its fill ESD valve is closed but ZSC-1102 / ZSC-1103 reads not closed. Also the reverse: I-103 blocking a close command it should release (a held open command lost, a ZSC fault), so a fill change cannot be completed.
consequence: The old selection valve closes the last open fill branch of the only lined-up tank in at least 30 s against the full rundown: the header pressure rises, PZT-1105 trips I-102 (trains tripped through XS-1100 as XV-1111..XV-1114 close in at least 30 s) and the header reaches at most the shut-off head of the trains' rundown pumps (open, hold H-05); a slow-closure surge (D-023 (3)); loss of production of the four trains. In the reverse case the fill point cannot be moved as AI-1102 / LTD-2103 call for, a delay of the rollover management (S8).
